label_home.zh: 此处所有发现均为探索性。

lead.en: Patterns across many policies, and the checks behind them.
lead.zh: 跨多项政策的规律，以及背后的核对。

en.head: With each paper’s own method, most published results reproduce within 10%
en.why: Where we differ, our estimate is closer to zero in {closer} of {other}.
en.numbers: {within} of {papers} papers, starting with the easiest data to get, differ from the published figure by no more than 10% of its size, or of its standard error if that is larger.

zh.head: 按每篇论文自己的方法重新估计，多数已发表结果能在 10% 内复现
zh.why: 有差距的 {other} 篇里，{closer} 篇我们的估计更接近零。
zh.numbers: 先从数据最容易拿到的论文做起，已重新估计 {papers} 篇，其中 {within} 篇与原文数值相差不超过 10%（以原文估计值的大小为基数；若其标准误更大，则以标准误为基数）。

en.head: Adopting states differ from the rest in party, ideology, income and urbanization
en.why: So comparing adopters with non-adopters picks up those differences too.
en.numbers: The gap is on average 2.84 standard deviations larger than when the same adoptions are handed to states at random (95% interval 1.50 to 4.18); 63 studies, 45 policy groups; in 34 of the 63 the gap alone is beyond chance, against 3.15 expected by chance.

zh.head: 采纳政策的州，在党派、意识形态、收入和城市化程度上都与其他州不同
zh.why: 所以直接拿采纳的州和没采纳的州比，比出来的也包含这些差异。
zh.numbers: 这一差距平均比把同一批采纳随机分给各州时大 2.84 个标准差（95% 区间 1.50 到 4.18）；63 项研究，45 个政策类别；63 项中有 34 项的差距单独看就超出随机范围，随机情形下预期约 3.15 项。

en.head: States adopt a policy faster when the party that favors it is in charge
en.why: The link shows up from 1990 and is not seen before.
en.numbers: Each step (from the other party in control, to split control, to this party in control) goes with 19% higher yearly odds that a state adopts for the first time (95% interval 10% to 28%); per step the odds ratio is 1.39 in 1990–2016 and 0.94 in 1961–1989; 166 policies, 4,309 adoptions.

zh.head: 政策偏向的那个党在州里执政时，采纳得更快
zh.why: 这种关系从 1990 年起才出现，之前未见。
zh.numbers: 控制权每向这个党靠近一步（从对方党执政，到两党分治，再到这个党执政），州在某一年首次采纳的几率高 19%（95% 区间 10% 到 28%）；每一步使几率在 1990–2016 年变为原来的 1.39 倍，在 1961–1989 年为 0.94 倍；166 项政策，4,309 次采纳。

en.head: Estimates for policies that reach many of the same states tend to move together
en.why: Results that share states count for less than the same number of independent ones.
en.numbers: Pairs of studies that share more of their adopting states move together more (slope +2.31 on the share of states in common, 95% interval 0.43 to 4.19); 226 study pairs, 28 studies.

zh.head: 影响许多相同州的政策，估计结果往往同升同降
zh.why: 共用州的结果，作为证据比同样数量的独立结果更弱。
zh.numbers: 两项研究共有的采纳州占比越高，估计越是同向变动（以共有州占比为自变量，斜率 +2.31，95% 区间 0.43 到 4.19）；226 个研究对，28 项研究。

how.en: How we checked: all numbers are computed from adoption records and our re-run estimates; a study is one policy’s rollout across US states.
how.zh: 核对方式：所有数字都由采纳记录和我们重新估计的结果计算而来；一项研究指一项政策在美国各州的推行。
